title: Bluegate Business Storage Account Past-Due Schedule
content:
For each program of the Bluegate Business Storage Account, the past-due schedule sets the late payment fee, the number of days past the invoice due date at which the account goes on credit hold, the services suspended while on hold, and the number of days past the due date at which an account still on hold is closed and referred to collections.

## Late payment fee and past-due thresholds

| Program | Late payment fee (share of the past-due invoice amount) | Minimum late payment fee | Calendar days past the due date: credit hold | Calendar days past the due date: closure and collections referral |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | 1.5% | $10.00 | 10 | 60 |
| Bluegate Business Plus | 1.5% | $10.00 | 10 | 60 |
| Bluegate Business Pro | 1.5% | $15.00 | 15 | 75 |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | 1.5% | $25.00 | 15 | 75 |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | 1.5% | $25.00 | 15 | 75 |
| Bluegate Business National Account | 1% | $50.00 | 30 | 90 |

## Services suspended while on credit hold

| Program | New agreements | Delivery acceptance | Conference room use | Forklift service |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | Suspended | — | — | — |
| Bluegate Business Plus | Suspended | Suspended | — | — |
| Bluegate Business Pro | Suspended | Suspended | Suspended | — |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | Suspended | Suspended | — | Suspended |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | Suspended | Suspended | — | — |
| Bluegate Business National Account | Suspended | Suspended | Suspended | Suspended |

A dash means the service is not on that program's list of services suspended by a credit hold.

## Points of reading

- Every program suspends new agreements while on hold. Only Essentials leaves delivery acceptance off the list.
- The percentage is 1.5% on every program except National Account, where it is 1%. The minimum fee rises with the program: $10.00, $10.00, $15.00, $25.00, $25.00 and $50.00.
- The hold threshold and the collections threshold are both counted in calendar days past the invoice due date: 10 and 60 on Essentials and Plus, 15 and 75 on Pro, Logistics and Fleet, 30 and 90 on National Account.
